references: Three user-supplied images; kept private, not redistributed.

comparisons.priority: Soft layered green and pink crowns, dark interiors, bright outer leaves
comparisons.implemented: Pointed oval leaf fans and five-petal blossom clusters on curved overlapping patches; cool interior shading and warm highlights.
comparisons.limits: No garden environment, grass, bloom or atmospheric lighting is reproduced.

comparisons.priority: Distinct full tree silhouettes with visible botanical branching
comparisons.implemented: Three side-by-side group and branch studies; existing broadleaf and Douglas-fir skeletons preserved.
comparisons.limits: The broadleaf and flowering studies share a generic oak skeleton. Blossoms do not identify an oak species or actual flowering behavior. Some patch repetition remains.

comparisons.priority: Horizontal conifer tiers and hanging feathered needle sprays
comparisons.implemented: Fir sprays follow source branch directions, with tapered branchlet atlases and downward curvature.
comparisons.limits: Needle density, taper and bark remain artist-directed. The silhouette is coarser and more regular than the supplied fir reference.

status: Prototype for user visual approval. Production forest renderer has not been modified.
